newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault RCI unit '96 results flat - paper.
newsitem.headline: Renault RCI unit '96 results flat - paper.

text.p: Renault Credit International, the finance subsidiary of French carmaker Renault SA, generated a profit roughly unchanged from the 751 million francs reported for 1995, the newspaper Le Monde said on Tuesday.

"For the first time in 10 years, Renault lost money in 1996. Only its financial activities were profitable: only Renault Credit Internationale (RCI), the subsidiary that groups them, has generated a profit comparable to that of the previous year (751 million francs)," Le Monde said.
Renault officials declined to comment. The group's results are due on March 20. It has predicted a group loss for 1996.
